preserved_boundaries: I understand is a grammatical observation, not proof that definitions are arbitrary opinions; proofs also contain we.
All merchant routes, Euclid reference, proportional numbers, four objections, historical labels and everyday scenes remain.
Prejudice genealogy is not the earlier formal proof; true ideas self-certainty is not I feel sure therefore true.
Names, causes and natures are distinct. Forty-eight numbered definitions are not exhaustive; joy is transition, not perfection itself.
Thirty-two chapters are not certified as thirty old plus two new. The full kinship relationships and every chapter cross-reference remain.
Stoics and Descartes remain Spinozas reported criticism. Memory and inference reservations are his; the dog story is not certified experiment.
Eternity is not indefinite temporal personal survival or before-body memory. Blessedness is not passing pleasure or wages; the direction to desire-restraint is not reversed.
Few-to-difficult is an observed inference, not a universal theorem; loquat analogy does not exhaust motives.
Latin Library remains a checking transcription, not the unspecified initial webpage or a new critical edition. Exact and approximate counts keep their different scope.
No aside is invented for intro or ep10. Nine existing SAE comparisons remain optional and explicitly not proofs.
limits: AI-assisted writing and independent editorial reading, not certification by human native speakers. Structural alignment and counts do not establish literary quality.
deployment: Local series commit only; author pushes.
